preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
Each test case N must be between 3 and 100,000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if N == 3 else any(P[i] ^ P[i+1] != P[i+2] for i in range(N-2))
postconditions.description: If N is 3, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation where the XOR condition is satisfied.

postconditions.expression: len(P) == N and all(1 <= x <= N for x in P) and len(set(P)) == N
postconditions.description: The output permutation P must contain N unique integers from 1 to N.
